name: Hermitage

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

keyfacts: Hermitage is a northern Rhône appellation that produces mostly red wine from Syrah, with small amounts of white from Marsanne and Roussanne.
Appellation rules allow Syrah to be topped up with 15% or less of Marsanne and/or Roussanne.
Because of their high tannin, the reds are usually aged longer than American or Australian Syrahs and are often cellared up to 40 years.
Vin de paille, or straw wine, is also produced in the region.

blurb.text: A northern Rhône appellation on a hill south of Lyon, making mostly red wine from Syrah. Small amounts of white are made from Roussanne and Marsanne. Some see the hill as the spiritual home of Syrah.
